title.b: Let Faith Arise In Our Praises

meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：游智婷

lines.a: 我的口 要不停讚美
lines.b: With my lips, I'll sing Your praises

lines.a: 我的手 要不停高舉
lines.b: With my hands, I'll lift up Your name

lines.a: 因祢應許 是我的信心
lines.b: For Your promises raise up my faith

lines.a: 每個困難中 我經歷神蹟
lines.b: In my troubled times, Your miracles come

lines.a: 讚美中 信心不斷升起
lines.b: In our praise, faith is ever rising

lines.a: 淚水中 我依然高聲唱
lines.b: Through our tears, we choose to sing our song

lines.a: 祢的信實 上達穹蒼
lines.b: You are faithful until the end

lines.a: 祢的應許 從不落空
讚美中 信心不斷升起
lines.b: In our praise, faith is ever rising

lines.a: 淚水中 我依然高聲唱
lines.b: We will sing the anthem of our faith

lines.a: 縱然前路迷茫 我心失望
lines.b: Even when we are lost, or discouraged

lines.a: 祢的話是燈 照耀前方
lines.b: Your word is a light, guiding our way
